title: Randomized conjugate gradient least squares
summary: We develop a novel randomized conjugate gradient least squares (RCGLS) method for solving least-squares problems, in which iterative sketching is employed at each step to reduce the dimension and hence the computational cost. In particular, we propose a new perspective on the classical CGLS method, where the next descent direction is determined via a constraint correction problem associated with the gradient.
